stories.headline: Investments spur industrial activity as demand falters
stories.summary: IIP grew 6.3% in FY27's first four months (vs 4% a year ago), led by capital goods (+15.4%); consumer non-durables stayed weak — recovery is investment-led, not demand-led.

stories.headline: On track to cut debt to 50% of GDP by 2030: FM
stories.summary: FM Nirmala Sitharaman reaffirmed the 50%-of-GDP debt target by 2030 and said a fertiliser shortage was avoided by keeping markets informed of India's supply needs.

stories.headline: Food vs fuel: Time to recalibrate
stories.summary: Sugar prices rose ~44% (Jul 24-Aug 24) on tight supply and festival demand. ICRIER's Gulati and Adhikari say ethanol-blending policy needs a rethink to ease food-price pressure.

stories.headline: Passive funds find favour with HNIs
stories.summary: HNI money in passive assets nearly tripled in five years, from 6.6% (Mar 2021) to 19.9% (Mar 2026), per [[AMFI]]/[[CRISIL]] data.

stories.headline: Stagger bets in top-rated bonds for steady cash flow
stories.summary: Corporate bonds yield 8-10% (AA-rated) and 11-14% (BBB-rated). Advisers recommend laddering maturities and favouring higher-rated issuers over yield-chasing.

stories.headline: Purple Style Labs (Pernia's Pop-Up Shop) opens ₹6,800-mn IPO
stories.summary: [[Purple Style Labs]]: price band ₹546-575/share, ₹6,800 mn fresh issue. FY26 loss ₹2,853.99 mn; flagged negative cash flows, high debt and brand dependence as key risks. Bid closes September 2, 2026.

stories.headline: Viceroy Hotels launches ₹10,583-lakh rights issue
stories.summary: [[Viceroy Hotels]]: up to 92,03,000 rights shares at ₹115/share (6:7 ratio), aggregating ₹10,583.45 lakh. Opens Sept 3, closes Sept 11, 2026; backed by promoter [[Loko Hospitality]].

stories.headline: Ducon Infratechnologies opens ₹24,994-lakh rights issue
stories.summary: [[Ducon Infratechnologies]]: up to 24,99,42,759 rights shares at ₹1 face value (10:13 ratio), aggregating ₹24,994.28 lakh. Opens Sept 3, closes Sept 10, 2026.

stories.headline: Augmont Enterprises IPO allotment finalised at ₹788/share
stories.summary: [[Augmont Enterprises]]: ₹8,250 mn IPO allotted at ₹788/share — 157.6x face value. QIB portion subscribed 237.94x, retail 33.08x. Listing on BSE/NSE expected around August 31, 2026.

stories.headline: Tax cuts fuel the drive; costlier oil can't brake it
stories.summary: GST rate cut keeps auto sales buoyant despite higher input costs. PV sales up 16.8% y-o-y (Jan-Mar), two-wheelers up 20.98%; E2W sales already beat 2025's full-year record in 8 months.

stories.headline: After Byju's fiasco, edtech finds a new growth model
stories.summary: Edtech pivots from funding-led growth to profitability. [[PhysicsWallah]]'s net loss narrowed 90% to ₹24 cr in FY26 on 35% revenue growth; [[upGrad]]'s loss fell 52% to ₹130 cr.

stories.headline: E2W sales hit new high, surpass 2025 record in just eight months
stories.summary: India's E2W registrations (Jan-Aug) hit 1.35 mn, beating 2025's full-year total. [[TVS]], [[Bajaj Auto]] and [[Ather]] lead; [[Ola Electric]] is the lone major laggard.

stories.headline: Rural resilience, urban catch-up: FMCG, durables hold up despite volatility
stories.summary: FMCG and durables demand held up despite crude-linked cost pressure from the West Asia conflict. FMCG value growth rose to 6.8% (Apr-Jun); AC sales up 20-25% y-o-y on heatwave demand.

stories.headline: Changing the game
stories.summary: Sports-rights costs are outpacing ad and subscription revenue for broadcasters. IPL media rights now valued at $20 bn ([[Houlihan Lokey]]), pushing networks toward kabaddi and football.

stories.headline: Tech Bytes: Gemini Enterprise for Legal, LTM's Kolkata hub, WhatsApp's tighter security
stories.summary: [[Google Cloud]] launched Gemini Enterprise for Legal; [[LTM]] opened a Kolkata AI delivery centre; [[WhatsApp]] expanded two-step verification and multi-passkey support on Android and iOS.

stories.headline: AI boom puts Jamnagar, Thane under water stress
stories.summary: Jamnagar and Thane rank among the world's most exposed sites to data-centre water stress; the two could account for 34% of global direct data-centre water use by 2030, per [[Rystad Energy]].

stories.headline: Flood toll nears 800 as Nepal prepares for mass cremation
stories.summary: Nepal moves to mass cremation amid a mortuary shortage; confirmed flood deaths at 781, ~2,500 still missing after an August 26 glacial-lake avalanche worsened flooding.

stories.headline: Modi arrives in Kyrgyzstan to attend SCO summit
stories.summary: PM Modi arrived in Bishkek for the 26th SCO Leadership Summit, with bilateral meetings planned on the sidelines; received by Kyrgyz Cabinet chairman Adylbek Kasymaliev.

stories.headline: White House exodus poses new challenge for Trump
stories.summary: Trump has lost his chief spokesperson, top legal adviser, a national security adviser and his Capitol Hill liaison in the past month, amid low approval ratings ahead of the midterms.

stories.headline: SpaceX launches NASA's Roman space telescope
stories.summary: NASA's ~$4-bn Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope launched on a [[SpaceX]] Falcon Heavy, headed to Lagrange Point 2 for a five-year mission probing dark energy, dark matter and exoplanets.

stories.headline: Anthropic wants AI to run machines
stories.summary: [[Anthropic]] previewed the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), letting AI agents operate lab and manufacturing machines; tests with [[Carnegie Mellon]] and [[Genentech]] cut integration time from weeks to hours.

stories.headline: Nvidia is making Silicon Valley think like China
stories.summary: US export curbs are pushing [[Meta]], [[Microsoft]] and [[OpenAI]] toward software that cuts AI-model memory needs by up to 96%, echoing techniques Chinese firms adopted after losing chip access.

stories.headline: Total overhaul of quality controls needed for doing business: Experts
stories.summary: Industry wants a full QCO review, not piecemeal fixes. QCOs rose from 88 (2019) to a peak of 790, now ~600; 72% of Japanese manufacturers in India report BIS-related impact, per [[JETRO]].

stories.headline: NCLAT upholds clean slate for Sintex Industries in insolvency case
stories.summary: NCLAT affirmed the 'clean slate principle' under the IBC, reinstating pre-resolution shareholders' rights and rejecting claims against a former [[Sintex Industries]] director.

stories.headline: Chandra says borrowers to settle ₹4,262-cr claims
stories.summary: Subhash Chandra says borrowers linked to his personal guarantees have assured settlement of the ₹4,262 cr claimed by lenders, subject to reconciliation.

stories.headline: Money that crosses the border & why the taxman is counting it
stories.summary: I-T dept launched a nationwide probe into suspicious outward remittances exceeding ₹30,000 cr over three years, covering 394 entities, 117 in border states and 36 professionals.

stories.headline: Companies notify AGMs and e-voting windows for FY26
stories.summary: AGM/EGM notices filed by [[KEI Industries]], [[Waaree Energies]], [[Valiant Laboratories]], [[Mold-Tek]], [[Tega Industries]], [[Bharat Forge]], [[NCDEX]], [[DCM]], [[Kalamandir Jewellers]], [[Harrisons Malayalam]], [[Acutaas Chemicals]], [[Websol Energy]], [[Onida Electronics]], [[Magnum Ventures]], [[Chalet Hotels]], [[Kanara Consumer]], [[Rajeswari Infrastructure]], [[Ace Alpha Tech]] and [[Kalyan Capitals]], most with remote e-voting via NSDL/CDSL. [[Jet Airways]] invited e-auction bids for six aircraft-linked lots; [[Creativity At Best Technologies]] and [[Astron Paper & Board Mill]] filed Form G insolvency invitations; [[Mangalore SEZ]] invited renewable-power e-tenders.

stories.headline: Banks and ARCs issue SARFAESI auction and demand notices across Maharashtra
stories.summary: [[Bank of Baroda]], [[Kotak Mahindra]], [[Muthoot Homefin]], [[IKF Home Finance]], [[Edelweiss ARC]], [[Hinduja Housing Finance]] and others published possession/e-auction notices for mortgaged properties across Pune, Navi Mumbai and Raigad, with auctions through Sept-Oct 2026.

stories.headline: Big investment treaties may include qualified MFN rule
stories.summary: Cabinet note on India's BIT revamp doubles post-deal investor protection to 10 years and proposes a qualified most-favoured-nation clause, balancing US/EU demands against curbs on third-party litigation funding.

stories.headline: India, Uzbekistan set $5-bn trade target by 2030
stories.summary: Modi and President Mirziyoyev elevated ties to a comprehensive strategic partnership and agreed a long-term uranium supply framework for India's civil-nuclear programme.

stories.headline: Commerce ministry to meet exporters on India-US trade issues on September 1
stories.summary: Commerce ministry to meet industry bodies on Sept 1 on India-US BTA performance, chaired by Additional Secretary Darpan Jain. Piyush Goyal visits US mid-Sept for the G-20 Trade Ministerial.

stories.headline: Dy MD Bharucha among two for HDFC CEO post
stories.summary: [[HDFC Bank]] likely to shortlist deputy MD Kaizad Bharucha as an internal CEO candidate alongside an external search, as Sashidhar Jagdishan retires in October.

stories.headline: 'I own it, you run it': Whirlpool tries new way to run an MNC
stories.summary: [[Whirlpool]] cut its India stake to ~40%, handed local management control, and asked the MD and CFO to co-invest, after Whirlpool India's market cap fell nearly 60% in two years.

stories.headline: 'Deepwater can boost India's energy security': BP India chairman Kartikeya Dube
stories.summary: [[BP]] India chairman Kartikeya Dube: the ₹84,084-cr Samudra Manthan programme has shifted BP's India focus to deepwater exploration in KG, Mahanadi and Saurashtra basins, deepening ties with [[ONGC]] and [[Reliance]].

stories.headline: Vi faces tariff dilemma as Jio, Airtel drive up Arpu
stories.summary: [[Vodafone Idea]] weighs a tariff hike against subscriber-recovery risk. Vi's ARPU rose to ₹195 (Q1FY27) but trails [[Jio]]'s ₹190 and [[Airtel]]'s ₹264.

stories.headline: CNH to invest ₹2,000 crore, double its tractor capacity
stories.summary: [[CNH India]] to invest ₹2,000 cr through 2030, doubling tractor capacity to 140,000 units, positioning India as a global hub for utility, light and compact tractors.

stories.headline: Scale achieved, promise unfinished
stories.summary: Jagdishan leaves [[HDFC Bank]] Oct 26 with the balance sheet up 77% since FY23 to ₹43.64 lakh cr — but also slower growth, weaker stock performance and governance controversies.

stories.headline: 'AI is shifting the value from code to context': Mastek CEO Umang Nahata
stories.summary: [[Mastek]] CEO Umang Nahata: the firm's 'Lead with AI' push is moving it from time-and-materials to outcome-based models, with strong demand in financial services, manufacturing and healthcare.

stories.headline: UG at home, PG abroad: how Tier-2 is shaping India's foreign education pipeline
stories.summary: Students increasingly do UG in India, PG abroad. Tier-2/3 cities now account for 79% of India's international student loans, per [[Prodigy Finance]].

stories.headline: Succession by scramble
stories.summary: Editorial: Jagdishan's exit from [[HDFC Bank]] is graceful, but the board's lack of succession planning isn't — leaving an interim chairman and an unfinished search.

stories.headline: A smarter return to work: AI-enabled reskilling for women professionals
stories.summary: India's female labour-force participation is 45.9% (urban: 27.7%, PLFS 2025). Experts say AI-enabled 'returnship' programmes could ease re-entry for women after career breaks.

stories.headline: A Fold for everyday tasks: Pixel 11 Pro Fold review
stories.summary: [[Google]]'s Pixel 11 Pro Fold (₹1,86,999, 16GB+512GB): Tensor G6 chip, 1-120Hz LTPO OLED display, 48MP+10.8MP+10.5MP camera setup; praised for thin, light build over pure spec superiority.

stories.headline: Earbuds get smarter, more connected
stories.summary: [[Plaud]]'s $250 wireless, 4G-connected earbuds record conversations and run AI-assistant tasks on the go, joining [[Meta]]'s Ray-Ban glasses and [[Apple]]'s AirPods in the 'always-on' AI audio wave.
